facts.fact: The Ministry of MSME publishes State-wise Udyam registration counts (micro, small, medium, total Udyam, Udyam Assist Platform IMEs and total MSMEs per State/UT) on the MSME Dashboard (dashboard.msme.gov.in, 'State Wise Udyam Registration')
facts.quote: State Wise Details S. No. State/UT Name Micro Small Medium Total Udyam IMEs (UAP) Total MSMEs

facts.fact: The dashboard's Udyam registration figures are real-time and shown with an 'As on' date, so any figure quoted must give that date
facts.quote: MSME Udyam Registration Including UAP R As on 28-10-2026

behaviour: Asks for (or uses) the user's State and gives only figures cited from the official MSME Dashboard / Udyam portal with their as-on date, or points the user to the State-wise Udyam registration page.
fail_if: It gives a State figure without a citation and date, or invents or estimates a number.
summary: Added: State-wise Udyam counts are published on the MSME Dashboard (State Wise Udyam Registration), real-time with an as-on date; no fixed number kept since it changes daily.
